messages:
alex: Hey team, quick question before my start date: I have a 401(k) at my previous employer and an HSA with an outside custodian. Can I roll the 401(k) into Redwood and transfer the HSA? Also any deadlines I should watch for on enrollments? cc @sophie

sophie (People Ops): Welcome! :tada: Yes to both in most cases. 401(k) trustee-to-trustee rollovers are supported. HSA trustee transfers are allowed too. Key enrollment deadlines: enroll in Workday for payroll deductions before the 5th of the month 23:59 PT for the next payroll. HSA pre-tax election must be set before that cutoff.

mike (Payroll): FYI on match and timing: employer match applies to deferrals made after your hire; rolled-in balances do not change match calculations retroactively. If you want deductions to start immediately, make sure your enrollment is completed in Workday and you meet the payroll cutoff. If you miss it, your elections start the following payroll cycle.

tara (Benefits): Rollover practicals: we accept trustee-to-trustee or a rollover check payable to the plan trustee. Please upload the rollover paperwork to Workday > Benefits > Documents and name it like "alex-401k-rollover.pdf" so we can find it. For HSA transfers, ask your custodian for an HSA trustee transfer form and DM me the custodian name if you want me to confirm the transfer instructions.

alex: Thanks! If I do a trustee-to-trustee HSA transfer, will my HSA balance be accessible immediately after transfer or is there a processing lag?

tara (Benefits): There can be a 5-10 business day processing window depending on the outgoing custodian. During that time you may not be able to use transferred funds. If you need immediate access, consider keeping the old card/account until the transfer completes.

sophie (People Ops): One more note on loans and vesting: plan allows participant loans up to plan limits; vesting on employer match is graded over 4 years (25% per year). If you have questions about loan treatment at separation, DM payroll.

welcome-bot: Onboarding checklist updated: "Upload 401k/HSA transfer docs" step added; benefits enrollment email scheduled on account activation. Link: https://hr.redwood.example/onboarding-checklist

alex: Perfect, uploading the forms now. Appreciate the help!
